title: Copilot agent workflow: linked issues are found via GraphQL closingIssuesReferences and commented after review is requested
answers: Copilot finished a PR but the linked issue got no comment, how is that issue found?
Where does the Copilot-agent workflow decide which issues to notify when a PR is ready for review?
Can I add another post-review step to the Copilot agent workflow that needs the PR's linked issues?
Where is the code that comments on issues linked to a Copilot-created PR handled?
body:
Path: .github/workflows/copilot-agent.yml, job comment-on-linked-issues (runs after publish-draft). Handles the Copilot-agent PR flow, which is triggered by pull_request_target review_requested; it looks up issues the PR is linked to and posts a comment on each.
Rule: The webhook payload does not include linked issues, so the job fetches them with a GraphQL query on pullRequest.closingIssuesReferences(first: 10), which the PR says covers both closing-keyword links and links made by assigning the issue to Copilot. If no issues come back, the job exits 0 without commenting; otherwise it runs gh issue comment for each issue number.
Constraints: Only the first 10 linked issues are commented. The job has issues: write and pull-requests: read permissions. Each run posts a new comment with no dedupe check, so re-requesting review repeats the comments (flagged in review, not handled here). The no-issues branch still prints "No linked issues.", so it is not fully silent. The assignment-link coverage claim comes from review discussion and was not verified against the GraphQL docs.
applies: Applies to the Copilot agent PR workflow in .github/workflows/copilot-agent.yml; does not cover other issue-linking automation such as closing-pr.js.
says: The linked issue was not commented on when the bot requested a review.
Why are comments missing on issues beyond the tenth one linked to the pull request?
Add an automated follow-up action for all linked issues once review is requested.
The bot did not post an update on the issue assigned to it.
Re-requesting review on a bot pull request posts another comment on the linked issue.
search: The Copilot agent workflow comments on linked issues by querying pullRequest.closingIssuesReferences(first: 10) in GraphQL during the comment-on-linked-issues job after review_requested. In .github/workflows/copilot-agent.yml, the job requires issues: write and pull-requests: read permissions and executes gh issue comment for each found issue, or exits 0 printing 'No linked issues.' Applies only to the Copilot agent PR workflow (not closing-pr.js), comments on at most 10 linked issues, lacks deduplication on review re-requests, and relies on unverified claims regarding assignment-link coverage.
